headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 13, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins secured a thrilling 7-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, while the St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 7-1. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the Athletics 8-4, and the Colorado Rockies edged out the Arizona Diamondbacks 6-4. In other news, the Boston Red Sox placed right-handed pitcher Garrett Whitlock on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Garrett Whitlock (Boston Red Sox, right elbow inflammation), James Outman (Detroit Tigers, concussion), Endy Rodríguez (Pittsburgh Pirates, left hip inflammation), Jake Bloss (Toronto Blue Jays, no specified injury), Riley Greene (Detroit Tigers, right hamstring strain), Kyle Karros (Colorado Rockies, concussion), José Suarez (Athletics, right hip strain), and Blake Treinen (Los Angeles Dodgers, right elbow inflammation).

The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade. The Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins, while the Athletics traded right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson to the Athletics for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 7-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins outlasted the Baltimore Orioles 7-5, securing a hard-fought win. Dylan Beavers led the Orioles' offense with a home run and three RBIs, while Yaramil Hiraldo impressed on the mound with 1.2 scoreless innings.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Phillies 7-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, securing a 7-1 victory. Alec Burleson led the Phillies' offense with 2 hits and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Athletics 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured an 8-4 victory over the Athletics, with Liam Hicks leading the offense. Hicks finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rockies Take Down Diamondbacks 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies secured a 6-4 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Brett Sullivan leading the offense with a home run and three RBIs. Gerardo Carrillo impressed in relief, striking out four batters in two scoreless innings.

top_news.title: **Red Sox RHP Garrett Whitlock Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Boston Red Sox right-handed pitcher Garrett Whitlock has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation, effective retroactive to August 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade. The deal is part of the larger trade involving Adley Rutschman, with a player to be named later still to be determined.
